title: コンピュータグラフィックス演習
subtitle: Computer Graphics Laboratory
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:

(1) Learn the history of computer graphics (CG).
(2) Gain an understanding of geometric transformation.
(3) Acquire knowledge and basic theory related to modeling.
(4) Acquire knowledge and basic theory related to rendering.
(5) Create CG works about regions.
advice:
This course aims to teach students how to the master basic theory and expression techniques of CG, after acquiring basic knowledge of the field such as the history, systems, intellectual property (IP) rights issue, and so on.

Students will also experientially learn basic theory related to coordinate transformation, modeling and rendering through lectures and practices by using three-dimensional CG (3DCG) software.

A basic outline of the course subjects is provided below:

1. What is CG, History of CG, and Construction of CG System
2. 2D and 3D Coordinate Transformation
3. Modeling
4. Rendering
5. Copyright (IP)
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of geometry learned in junior and senior high school is required.
Knowledge related to physical optics is required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand history and system of CG.
Be able to understand geometric transformation and create shapes by using it.
Be able to understand the basic knowledge and theory of modeling and express basic shapes.
Be able to understand the basic knowledge and theory of rendering and output realistic image.
Be able to create CG works about regions.
